$ cat testdata/script/twice.txtar
A1 is twice B1. The root package, ., prints it with echo, and ./b with shout.
-- in/note/text --
A note.
-- properties --
circular
-- gaps --
shout A1 is SIX. Waits on sheets#14.
format A1 prints as =6. Waits on sheets#8.
-- in/do/out/values.txt --
A1 6
-- in/shout/out/values.txt --
A1 SIX
-- in/do/edit --
gaps
format A1 prints as =6. Waits on sheets#8.
-- out/echo/inputs --
values.txt
  in/do/out/values.txt
-- out/echo/outcome --
accepted
-- out/echo/values.txt --
A1 6
